If you're using an iPhone 16 or later model, you might want to consider a Qi2.2 charger to take full advantage of the 25W MagSafe charging capabilities your phone supports. Anker's brand-new 25W Prime MagSafe 3-in-1 charger is one of many excellent options, and it features an exceptionally portable design.

First impressions

The major trend in the second half of 2025 has been bringing 25W Qi2.2 to every wireless charging accessory, and this momentum has continued into 2026. Anker was the first to kick things off, launching a portable MagSafe 3-in-1 charger that integrates 25W Qi2.2 support into an extremely compact design.

To achieve 25W wireless charging, active cooling is almost essential. Nearly every 25W charger on the market comes with built-in cooling, and Anker's new folding 3-in-1 charger is no exception.

The package includes a 45W charger and USB-C cable, providing ample power to charge your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch simultaneously. With this desktop charger, you can get your iPhone 18 Pro to 50% in just 27 minutes.

Remember the MagSafe Duo? If you were a fan of that product before Apple discontinued it, you'll likely love this new offering. Its portability is remarkably similar to the MagSafe Duo, but with two major improvements: it can be used as a desktop stand, and it can charge three devices simultaneously rather than two.

This charger has a rather interesting (though admittedly unnecessary) feature—the Apple Watch charger uses a spring-loaded design. When you fold the charger up, it retracts inward; but when you're ready to unfold it for use, simply press down and it pops out. I find this design quite clever, and it makes the product's higher price tag feel more justified.

Conclusion

Overall, if you're looking for a quality MagSafe 3-in-1 charger that's great for travel, this new Anker product is an excellent choice. With built-in active cooling, it can quickly charge your iPhone while avoiding overheating and other issues that sometimes come with wireless charging.

Anker's new MagSafe 3-in-1 charger is now available on Amazon, with same-day delivery for Prime members at $99, offered in both black and white.
